title: Flow Matching in Feature Space for Stochastic World Modeling
author: Francois Porcher; Nicolas Carion; Karteek Alahari; Shizhe Chen
summary: This paper introduces FlowWM, a new model that predicts uncertain futures directly in rich feature spaces from pretrained visual encoders. FlowWM improves on past methods by better capturing diverse future possibilities and maintaining useful information for tasks like object detection and depth estimation. The authors also provide new benchmarks showing FlowWM outperforms other models on predicting future visual features for perception tasks.
